record.Description: This recall involves Kesyup-branded Mattresses. They are 12 inches thick and were sold in twin, full, queen and king sizes. They have a white top and blue sides with blue trim. The mattresses were sold in compressed boxes. “Prototype ID: PU-US” is printed on a sewn-in white label on one side of the mattress.
record.Title: ZCK01 Recalls Kesyup Mattresses Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standard for Mattress Flammability

Images.Caption: "Prototype ID: " is printed on a sewn-in white label on one side of the recalled Kesyup mattress

Manufacturers.Name: S-Q Business (HK) Limited, dba ZCK01, of China

Retailers.Name:
Sold Online At:
Amazon.com from December 2024 through April 2026 for between $100 and $200.

Hazards.Name: The recalled mattresses violate the mandatory flammability standard for mattresses, posing a risk of serious injury or death from fire.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled mattresses immediately and contact ZCK01 for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to destroy the mattress by writing in permanent marker “Recalled,” their name and the date on mattress’ top surface, and to email a photo of the destroyed mattress to keysup123@163.com. Consumers should then dispose of the recalled product in accordance with local and/or state disposal procedures.

ai.summary: ZCK01 has recalled approximately 48,405 Kesyup-branded mattresses because they fail to meet mandatory federal flammability standards. This defect poses a fire hazard that could lead to severe injuries or death.
ai.next_steps: Owners should stop sleeping on the mattresses right away and reach out to ZCK01 for a complete refund. To qualify, use a permanent marker to write "Recalled," your name, and the date across the top of the mattress, email a photo of the marked bed to keysup123@163.com, and then discard it following your local or state disposal rules.
